description: This Java class defines EntityStoreOptions, a configuration object used within the Apache OFBiz framework to specify options related to storing GenericEntity objects, particularly whether or not to create dummy foreign key references when storing entities.

classes.name: EntityStoreOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates options for storing entities, specifically whether to create dummy foreign key references.

methods.name: EntityStoreOptions()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the options with default values.

methods.name: EntityStoreOptions(boolean createDummyFks)
methods.description: Constructor allowing to specify whether dummy foreign keys should be created.

methods.name: isCreateDummyFks()
methods.description: Getter that indicates if dummy foreign keys will be created during entity storage.

methods.name: setCreateDummyFks(boolean createDummyFks)
methods.description: Setter to specify if dummy foreign keys should be created during storage.
